deviations: Signed out (is_authorized=false): AI-generated models, images, and RSG tokens are unavailable until sign-in; no generated images planned, no TTS.
Manikin is a code-authored primitive stand-in (head, neck, torso, arms) per brief, not an AI mesh; backend hint 'code-authored' (MeshBuilder/primitives).
Hands guide and heart use existing Assets/Textures/hands_white.png, hands_green.png, heart.png on unlit alpha-blended planes; no replacement assets generated.
No music: brief/notes specify only a 110 BPM beat click.

theme.style: realistic, clean, medical training, frosted glass UI
theme.palette: light neutral grey, bright white, soft green confirm, emergency red #F2392C accent

assets.name: Manikin
assets.description: adult CPR training manikin lying face-up on its back, built from simple rounded primitives: sphere head, short cylinder neck, broad capsule torso with flat chest, two capsule arms resting at its sides; uniform light neutral grey matte

assets.name: BeatClick
assets.description: very short crisp dry metronome click, tight transient under 40 ms, one per beat at 110 BPM, clearly audible but not harsh

assets.name: ButtonPress
assets.description: soft short UI confirm tap for pinching the step button

assets.name: HoldComplete
assets.description: brief gentle rising two-tone confirm chime when the 1 second hands-in-place hold completes

assets.name: warning
assets.description: alert icon for the Check step tab

assets.name: call
assets.description: phone icon for the Call 112 step tab

assets.name: back_hand
assets.description: hand icon for Watch first / Place hands / Hold step tab

assets.name: monitor_heart
assets.description: heartbeat icon for Push / Swap step tab

assets.name: check_circle
assets.description: check icon for Help is here step tab

assets.name: CPRCoachUI
assets.description: Frosted-glass light translucent grey step window with vertical step tab bar on its left edge; light text for additive display; one card visible at a time; switches between head-follow and chest-anchored placement

elements.name: stepWindow
elements.description: Frosted glass rounded window: small 60% white step label, large white semibold instruction, counter as the largest element, readable from 60-80 cm
labels: Call 112. Put the phone on speaker.
Match your hands to the guide. Arms straight. Shoulders over hands.
Swap with someone if you can

elements.name: actionButton
elements.description: Single large pinch button inside the window; red #F2392C on Check, hidden on Place hands and Hold; highlights on hover

elements.name: holdProgress
elements.description: Short horizontal progress bar filling over 1 s, visible only in Hold step, resets to empty on early release

elements.name: stepTabBar
elements.description: Vertical glass capsule on the left edge of the window with 5 round icon tabs (warning, call, back_hand, monitor_heart, check_circle); active = filled white circle with dark icon, finished = white icon, upcoming = 45% opacity; display-only
